verdict.rationale: Daytona publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json. Its first-party docs reference the Daytona API alongside official Python and TypeScript SDKs (plus Go and Ruby) for programmatically managing sandboxes, so it can be driven through a documented public API. Missing for 10: detailed API reference content in the evidence (authentication, endpoint coverage), and independent or hands-on corroboration of direct API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Includes references and practical patterns for the Daytona API, CLI, Python, TypeScript, Go, and Ruby SDKs.
The Daytona Python SDK provides a robust interface for programmatically interacting with Daytona Sandboxes.
The Daytona TypeScript SDK provides a powerful interface for programmatically interacting with Daytona Sandboxes.
Sandboxes are isolated runtime environments you can manage programmatically to run code.
